text: 结果正如你所担心的那样。查理是在请求你杀了她。她亲口告诉过你，变成风行者的人心脏会结冰，而融化那颗心脏就能杀死怪物。
查理颤抖着，摇摇欲坠地站在烧焦的残足上。她正与灵魂中的恶魔搏斗，为你争取行动时间。但她脸上的人性正逐渐消退，双眼闪烁着冰冷的光。你仍拿不定主意，却从火中举起一根烧得通红的木棍。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 212
text: The answer is as you fear. Charlie is asking for her death. She herself told you that one who becomes a wind-walker has a heart of ice—and melting that heart slays the monster.

Charlie trembles, tottering on her charred stumps of feet. She is battling with the demon in her soul, giving you time to act. But the humanity in her face is fading. Her eyes shine with a cold light. Still unsure, you lift a stiff, blazing brand from the fire.
